Young people are naturally curious and prone to exploring new ideas. However, as they grow older, it becomes increasingly important for them to develop a sense of responsibility and maturity. This means putting aside immature or rebellious thoughts and ideas, and instead embracing a more thoughtful and respectful approach to life. By doing so, young people can better contribute to society and lead fulfilling lives.
